title: Ullatan language - Wikipedia
text: January 1, 2026 - Ullatan (IPA: [uɭːaːɖɐn]) is an apparently extinct Southern Dravidian language once spoken by two Scheduled tribes of India. Ullatan is also known as Katan, Kattalan, Kochuvelan and Ulladan.
